svg.text: Revive — one action that puts a man back in the fight (house style; Injury States §9)
Scope: the Strength row's Revive button only. Other rows are context, unchanged. Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Revive — back in the fight: full health,
wounds and stun cleared, can move and fire.
His brain starts idle and takes orders again.
A — DEAD or INCAPACITATED: the green heart-pulse
button trails the Strength row; hover says what it does.
B — clicked: one edit to the man's owner (this node or
another). The row is pending until the answer; a refusal
shows the usual red cross with the reason.
C — applied: 100 / 100, the button is gone (offered only
while he is wounded, incapacitated or dead). He gets up
from where he lay; posture is his brain's again.
Also on: every host that draws the Unit form (Editor, CGF, SimHost station) — Edit mode and Live; greyed in Review / a recording, like every row.
Not a hack in the Strength field: typing a number there sets ONLY the number (R-11021). Revive is the one action that does the rest.
